security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Footage Selects scores every clip for focus, exposure and camera stability using classical image math, picks the best moments, and exports a timeline for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro and Final Cut Pro. It works fully offline.
